Brad, saw Zingtree is scaling its no-code AI agent platform into more regulated industries off the Series A.

Growth like that usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Zingtree off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Brad, quick follow-up for Zingtree.

After a raise, expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Zingtree needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brad, last bit of proof for Zingtree.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Zingtree's reply rate likely compares to peer Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I will tailor it to Zingtree either way.
